title: Deep-merge user settings over defaults
description: Adds a small recursive merge helper and the settings endpoint that applies an incoming update on top of the stored defaults.

expected.note: The merge copies every key from untrusted source into target, including __proto__/constructor/prototype, so a request body like {"__proto__":{"isAdmin":true}} pollutes Object.prototype process-wide. Skip dangerous keys and build the result on a null-prototype object (or use Object.create(null) / a vetted merge).
